title: Investigating intelligent generation of multimodal creative stimuli in conceptual design: strategies and implications
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper explores the intelligent generation of multimodal creative stimuli in conceptual design, focusing on strategies and implications. It introduces a system called InsPilot that generates stimuli based on design stages, ideas, and input states. A comparative study with GPT-4V is conducted to evaluate the system's effectiveness in supporting design creativity.
